QuestInfo.name: [Shaolin Temple] Finding the Secret Library
QuestInfo.0: You helped #b#p9310047##k, but now it's time to get to #b#m701220300##k and find the Secret Library. Is there a way?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9310047##k says that you will be bombarded with attacks in #m701220300# if you aren't a demon.\nDrink the metamorph potion that #b#p9310047##k gave you to #rtransform into a demon for 3 minutes#k. That should give you a chance to look for the Secret Library.\r\nThe quest must be forfeited and re-accepted when failing.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to find the location of the Secret Library while transformed as a demon.
